title: Suspicious KYC Update with Phishing Link

data.summary: The message is a phishing attempt to trick the user into updating their SBI NetBanking credentials.
data.explanation: It contains an urgent request for immediate action (visit URL) and uses a generic bank name ('SBI') in combination with a specific product ('NetBanking'), which are common tactics of scammers. The link provided is also suspicious as it redirects to 'verify' without any indication that the site is legitimate.

red_flags.description: Suspicious URL with generic bank name and product mention

recommended_actions: Do not click the link and verify your credentials through official SBI channels.
